fato_historico: 1976: Dozens are killed by Thai police and right-wing paramilitaries in the Thammasat University massacre; afterwards, the Seni Pramoj government is toppled in a military coup led by Sangad Chaloryu.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider how the world shifts through contrast. Just as silence often follows the loudest storm, you may find that deep introspection helps you navigate internal turbulence. It is a good time to focus on peace and equilibrium, allowing your inner light to shine brighter than any surrounding shadows. Trust that gentle steps lead to lasting serenity.
frase_do_dia: True balance is found by turning inward when the world feels chaotic.
significado_numero: Represents the seeker of truth and the wisdom of inner reflection.
conselho: Choose kindness and let diplomacy guide your interactions throughout this transformative day.
